IGNEOUS:
(1) आग्ने यः (यी, यं);
(2) वह्रिमयः (यी,
 यं).

IGNITE:
I Trans: ज्वलयति (c. of ज्वल्): v.
To kindle.
II Intrans:
(1) ज्वलति (ज्वल्,
c. 1.);
(2) समिध्यते (pass. of इन्ध).

IGNOBLE: नीचः (चा, चं): v. Mean, base,
low.
IGNOBLY: expr. by adj.: v. Also meanly.

IGNOMINIOUS: यशोघ्न (f. घ्नी): v. Infamous,
shameful, base.

IGNOMINY:
(1) निकृतिः,
did not bear the i. of
being removed from the front seat:
साग्रासनापनयजा
 निकृतिर्न सोढा, Mu. iv. ii.;
(2) न्यक्कारः, Vi. v.
22.: v. Disgrace.

IGNORANCE:
I Absol.: अज्ञानम्।
II In special
subjects: अनमिञ्जता,
i. of algebra:
बीजानभिञ्जता।
Ph.:
I will keep her in i. of it:
न तामेतदभिञ्जां
 करोमि: v. Also to conceal; to be in i. of:
अनभिञ्ज (f. ञ्जा) (with gen.).
IGNORE (v): न स्वीकरोति: v. To admit, not.
